page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 72 dedicated vCPUs and 72 physical cores, running on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage must be network-attached. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. However, it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication with external storage volumes and other network resources.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is designed for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of shared-core resource contention. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-density resource configuration suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, and general-purpose workloads that demand substantial memory and processing capacity but do not require local storage or GPU acceleration.
